confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Chilean tourist-town pricing, not inspected live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is more seasonal and variable. July is Chilean winter and a high season for domestic school holidays and international tourists, and the remote desert location adds a price premium. FX observation 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 is taken from search-result text attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not directly read the RBA table, and a third-party site listed a different 2026-10-16 figure that I could not verify against rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional knowledge of high-demand Chilean and Andean tourist towns (for example Pucón and Cusco), adjusted upward for San Pedro de Atacama's remote location and supply-constrained lodging in peak season. No direct city-specific source was used.
